impact:
Found while verifying the 2026-08-31 deploy. ISS-047 added a durable per-tenant synthesis-status.json so a failure survives the process and can be surfaced. It is written server-side, but handleSyncPull does NOT include it in the pull payload — it returns observations, sessions, growth, reinforcements, lessons, persona, playbook and active, and nothing else.

CONSEQUENCE: for a synced user (ZUG_URL set, which is the paid/canonical path), ~/.zug/synthesis-status.json never appears. The T-058 dashboard reads that local file, so its "LAST SYNTHESIS" tile reads "never run" permanently, no matter what the server actually did. Confirmed on the live machine after deploy: the file is absent locally while the server has been running the new code.

The MCP zug_status tool is unaffected — it executes server-side and reads the server's copy — so the gap is specific to anything reading the local data directory. That is exactly the dashboard, and it will get worse as more views depend on locally-synced state.

Note the asymmetry this creates: the one surface built to make synthesis failure visible is the surface that cannot see it.

FIX DIRECTION: add `synthesisStatus` to PullResponse in sync-types.ts, return it from handleSyncPull, and write it in sync.ts's pull alongside persona/playbook/active. It is a single small JSON object with no merge semantics needed — last-writer-wins from the canonical server is correct, since the server is the only thing that synthesizes for a synced user.

Alternatively the dashboard could read status via the MCP tool rather than the file, but that turns a read-only local page into a network client, which the T-058 design deliberately avoided.
resolution:
Fixed in b714a39, deployed and verified end-to-end 2026-08-31.

SYNC (ISS-049 proper): PullResponse gains `synthesisStatus`; handleSyncPull returns readSynthesisStatus(); sync.ts's pull writes it through a new storage.writeSynthesisStatus. Projected down like persona/playbook/active rather than merged — for a synced user the server is the only thing that synthesizes, so last-writer-wins from the server is correct. The client write is guarded (`if (data.synthesisStatus)`) because a client can be newer than its server; a regression test covers an older server that omits the field entirely.

writeSynthesisStatus is deliberately distinct from recordSynthesisOutcome: the latter composes a new status and preserves the LOCAL cursor, which is exactly the wrong semantics here where the server's cursor is authoritative.

BACKLOG SURFACING (added, and the reason this ticket mattered): shipping only the outcome would have rebuilt the blind spot one layer up. `outcome: ok` describes the last batch and says nothing about observations never offered — precisely how ISS-050 read healthy while 66 observations sat unabsorbed. New synthesisBacklog() in web/lib/zug-metrics.ts compares observations against lastSynthesizedAt and returns {pending, oldestPendingAt, known}. The tile warns when the oldest pending observation has aged past BACKLOG_STALE_DAYS = 1 — age rather than raw count, so a long session does not cry wolf while a single stuck observation still does. When the server sends no cursor the backlog reports known:false (UNKNOWN) rather than 0, because claiming zero would assert a health that cannot be verified.

VERIFIED LIVE:
- Before: ~/.zug/synthesis-status.json did not exist (the ISS-049 symptom).
- After deploy + `zug pull`: the file landed with {"outcome":"ok","timestamp":"2026-08-31T16:44:04.983Z","lastSynthesizedAt":"2026-08-31T16:35:30.593Z"} — both the outcome and the ISS-050 cursor.
- Dashboard rendered against real data at localhost:3000/dashboard: the LAST SYNTHESIS tile now reads "Last succeeded 2026-08-31. 1 pending, awaiting next push." (status good), where it previously read "never run" permanently.

TESTS: src/sync-synthesis-status.test.ts (5 cases, all failed before the fix), 2 new sync.test.ts cases, 6 synthesisBacklog cases in web/lib/zug-metrics.test.ts including a reproduction of the real ISS-050 shape (outcome ok + 3 stranded observations). Server 286 passed, web 46 passed, both typechecks clean, web verification build clean into a scratch dist dir.

FOLLOW-UP FOUND WHILE VERIFYING: the adjacent Persona tile reports "0d frozen" as critical off two growth snapshots 16 minutes apart. Filed separately.
title: Synthesis status never reaches a synced client — dashboard always reports "never run"
